profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Walmart Global Tech
profile.summary: A Computer Science Graduate with 3 years of experience as a Software Developer is seeking to find opportunity in a fun and challenging working environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working with a team in an agile environment for the development of asp.net core mvc architecture based web apps deployed on azure cloud. 
Technologies used : Asp.net core, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Azure devops, Azure tables, power app, power automate flow, xunit.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Building Websites from prototypes.
•	Solving Customer tickets for Website development / update / feature enhancements.

positions.title: Intern - Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
• As an intern at Kisserra, my focus was to add new features in the e-commerce
website.
• Maintaining the website.
• Making the website responsive across platforms.
• Resolved Cross Browser Compatible Issues for different version of IE, Safari,
Chrome, Firefox and Opera.
• Maintained and updated HTML/CSS templates on a regular basis and as
required
• The website is built using Wordpress - Woocommerce

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• As an intern at Campsite, I am working along with the team here to build UI for
an app.
• The project is for the World Bank. We are building a mobile app to view and
approve photos that have been crowd-sourced and uploaded by users around
the world.
• The mobile app displays the image and the Product ID/Product Name on the
screen. The user will swipe left if they match or right if they do not match.
• The app is built using HTML5, CSS3, Javascript.

projects.title: Library Management System - Website
projects.description: FrontEnd Development for Library Management System - where user(Library Admin) can add books to the database, checkout books, add different libraries, etc.

projects.title: Smart Parking
projects.description:
The project was made as a part of Internet of Things course. 
SmartPark project allows users to view available parking slots in real time and also reserve a slot.
HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor was used alongside Raspberry Pi - 3 and Android Phone.
